title: post apiv1authregister with valid data
description: Test user registration with valid name, email, phone, and password to receive 201 status with user object and token.

title: post apiv1authlogin with valid credentials
description: Test user login with correct email and password to receive 200 status with access_token, refresh_token, and user object.

title: post apiv1authverifyotp with correct otp
description: Test OTP verification by posting phone and valid OTP to receive 200 status confirming verification.

title: post apiv1authrefresh with valid refresh token
description: Test access token refresh by posting with valid refresh token to receive 200 status with new access_token.

title: post apiv1authlogout with valid access token
description: Test user logout by posting with valid access token to receive 200 status confirming logout.

title: get apiv1restaurants returns active restaurants
description: Test retrieval of all active restaurants without authentication to receive 200 status with list of restaurant objects.

title: post apiv1orders places new order
description: Test placing a new order with valid restaurant_id, items, delivery_address, and payment_method_id after authentication to receive 201 status with order object.

title: post apiv1paymentscreateintent with valid amount and currency
description: Test creation of Stripe payment intent by posting valid amount and currency after authentication to receive 200 status with client_secret.

title: patch apiv1driversidlocation updates driver location
description: Test updating driver location by patching with valid latitude and longitude after authentication to receive 200 status confirming update.

title: get apiv1trackingorderid returns live tracking info
